name: 21 - API - Process Disruption Patient Decision - Standalone Final

assignments.name: decision_note
assignments.value: درخواست بیمار در فرایند تغییر برنامه پزشک

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS disruption_case_id,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS decision,
        $4::INTEGER AS option_number,
        $5::TEXT AS decision_note,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($6::INTEGER, 1),
            5
        ) AS options_per_patient,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($7::INTEGER, 1),
            60
        ) AS additional_search_days
),

case_context AS (
    SELECT
        dc.id AS disruption_case_id,
        dc.exception_id,
        dc.appointment_id,
        dc.status AS case_status,
        dc.proposed_slots,

        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,

        a.starts_at AS original_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS original_ends_at,
        a.status AS appointment_status,
        a.google_calendar_event_id
            AS old_calendar_event_id,

        se.ends_at AS exception_ends_at,
        se.reason AS exception_reason,

        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        r.decision,
        r.option_number,
        r.decision_note,
        r.options_per_patient,
        r.additional_search_days

    FROM appointment_disruption_cases dc

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.disruption_case_id = dc.id

    INNER JOIN appointments a
        ON a.id = dc.appointment_id

    INNER JOIN schedule_exceptions se
        ON se.id = dc.exception_id

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.id = a.clinic_id
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN patients p
        ON p.id = a.patient_id
       AND p.mobile = r.mobile

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    WHERE dc.status IN (
        'awaiting_reschedule_consent',
        'awaiting_waitlist_consent'
    )

    LIMIT 1
),

selected_slot AS (
    SELECT
        cc.*,

        (slot_item ->> 'option_number')::INTEGER
            AS selected_option_number,

        (slot_item ->> 'starts_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ
            AS selected_starts_at,

        (slot_item ->> 'ends_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ
            AS selected_ends_at

    FROM case_context cc

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
        cc.proposed_slots
    ) AS slot_item

    WHERE cc.decision = 'reschedule'
      AND (
            slot_item ->> 'option_number'
      )::INTEGER = cc.option_number

    LIMIT 1
),

selected_slot_state AS (
    SELECT
        ss.*,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM schedule_exceptions se

            WHERE se.doctor_id = ss.doctor_id
              AND se.is_active = TRUE
              AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

              AND se.starts_at < ss.selected_ends_at
              AND se.ends_at > ss.selected_starts_at
        ) AS is_blocked,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointments existing

            WHERE existing.doctor_id = ss.doctor_id
              AND existing.id <> ss.appointment_id

              AND existing.status IN (
                  'pending',
                  'confirmed'
              )

              AND existing.starts_at <
                    ss.selected_ends_at

              AND existing.ends_at >
                    ss.selected_starts_at
        ) AS has_conflict

    FROM selected_slot ss
),

candidate_dates AS (
    SELECT
        cc.*,
        generated_day::DATE AS candidate_date

    FROM case_context cc

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SERIES(
        GREATEST(
            (
                cc.exception_ends_at
                AT TIME ZONE cc.timezone
            )::DATE,

            (
                NOW()
                AT TIME ZONE cc.timezone
            )::DATE
        ),

        GREATEST(
            (
                cc.exception_ends_at
                AT TIME ZONE cc.timezone
            )::DATE,

            (
                NOW()
                AT TIME ZONE cc.timezone
            )::DATE
        )
        + cc.additional_search_days,

        INTERVAL '1 day'
    ) AS generated_day

    WHERE cc.decision = 'more_options'
),

generated_more_slots AS (
    SELECT
        cd.*,

        slot.slot_start_local,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE cd.timezone
            AS candidate_starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                mins => cd.duration_minutes
            )
        ) AT TIME ZONE cd.timezone
            AS candidate_ends_at

    FROM candidate_dates cd

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = cd.doctor_id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE

       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(
                ISODOW FROM cd.candidate_date
            )::INTEGER

       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= cd.candidate_date
       )

       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= cd.candidate_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SERIES(
        cd.candidate_date + ds.start_time,

        cd.candidate_date
            + ds.end_time
            - MAKE_INTERVAL(
                mins => cd.duration_minutes
            ),

        MAKE_INTERVAL(
            mins =>
                cd.duration_minutes
                + cd.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)
),

available_more_slots AS (
    SELECT
        gs.*

    FROM generated_more_slots gs

    WHERE gs.candidate_starts_at > NOW()
      AND gs.candidate_starts_at >=
            gs.exception_ends_at

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM schedule_exceptions se

          WHERE se.doctor_id = gs.doctor_id
            AND se.is_active = TRUE
            AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

            AND se.starts_at <
                  gs.candidate_ends_at

            AND se.ends_at >
                  gs.candidate_starts_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointments existing

          WHERE existing.doctor_id =
                gs.doctor_id

            AND existing.id <>
                gs.appointment_id

            AND existing.status IN (
                'pending',
                'confirmed'
            )

            AND existing.starts_at <
                  gs.candidate_ends_at

            AND existing.ends_at >
                  gs.candidate_starts_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
              gs.proposed_slots
          ) old_slot

          WHERE (
                old_slot ->> 'starts_at'
          )::TIMESTAMPTZ =
                gs.candidate_starts_at
      )
),

ranked_more_slots AS (
    SELECT
        available.*,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                available.candidate_starts_at
        ) AS slot_rank

    FROM available_more_slots available
),

limited_more_slots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_more_slots
    WHERE slot_rank <= options_per_patient
),

more_slot_summary AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS proposed_slot_count,

        COALESCE(
            JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'option_number',
                        slot_rank,

                    'appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            candidate_starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),

                    'start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            candidate_starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            candidate_ends_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'starts_at',
                        candidate_starts_at,

                    'ends_at',
                        candidate_ends_at
                )
                ORDER BY candidate_starts_at
            ),
            '[]'::JSONB
        ) AS proposed_slots

    FROM limited_more_slots
),

rescheduled_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments a

    SET
        starts_at = selected.selected_starts_at,
        ends_at = selected.selected_ends_at,

        reschedule_count =
            COALESCE(
                a.reschedule_count,
                0
            ) + 1,

        rescheduled_at = NOW(),

        last_reschedule_reason =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    selected.decision_note,
                    ''
                ),
                'جابه‌جایی پس از تغییر برنامه پزشک'
            ),

        google_calendar_event_id = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM selected_slot_state selected

    WHERE selected.decision = 'reschedule'
      AND a.id = selected.appointment_id

      AND a.status IN (
          'pending',
          'confirmed'
      )

      AND selected.selected_starts_at > NOW()
      AND selected.is_blocked = FALSE
      AND selected.has_conflict = FALSE

    RETURNING
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.starts_at AS new_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS new_ends_at,
        a.status,
        a.reschedule_count,
        a.rescheduled_at
),

reschedule_history AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_reschedule_history (
        appointment_id,
        old_starts_at,
        old_ends_at,
        new_starts_at,
        new_ends_at,
        reason,
        source
    )

    SELECT
        cc.appointment_id,
        cc.original_starts_at,
        cc.original_ends_at,
        ra.new_starts_at,
        ra.new_ends_at,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(cc.decision_note, ''),
            'جابه‌جایی پس از تغییر برنامه پزشک'
        ),

        'disruption_management'

    FROM case_context cc

    INNER JOIN rescheduled_appointment ra
        ON ra.appointment_id =
           cc.appointment_id

    RETURNING id AS history_id
),

rescheduled_case AS (
    UPDATE appointment_disruption_cases dc

    SET
        status = 'rescheduled',
        patient_decision = 'reschedule',

        selected_starts_at =
            ra.new_starts_at,

        selected_ends_at =
            ra.new_ends_at,

        decision_note =
            cc.decision_note,

        responded_at = NOW(),
        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    INNER JOIN rescheduled_appointment ra
        ON ra.appointment_id =
           cc.appointment_id

    WHERE dc.id = cc.disruption_case_id

    RETURNING
        dc.id AS disruption_case_id,
        dc.status AS case_status
),

cancelled_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments a

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',

        cancellation_reason =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    cc.decision_note,
                    ''
                ),
                'لغو نوبت پس از تغییر برنامه پزشک'
            ),

        cancelled_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    WHERE cc.decision = 'cancel'
      AND a.id = cc.appointment_id

      AND a.status IN (
          'pending',
          'confirmed'
      )

    RETURNING
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.status,
        a.cancellation_reason,
        a.cancelled_at
),

cancelled_case AS (
    UPDATE appointment_disruption_cases dc

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        patient_decision = 'cancel',

        decision_note =
            cc.decision_note,

        responded_at = NOW(),
        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    INNER JOIN cancelled_appointment ca
        ON ca.appointment_id =
           cc.appointment_id

    WHERE dc.id = cc.disruption_case_id

    RETURNING
        dc.id AS disruption_case_id,
        dc.status AS case_status
),

inserted_waitlist AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_waitlist (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,

        original_appointment_id,
        disruption_case_id,

        desired_from,
        desired_to,

        status,
        priority,
        consent_given_at,

        notes,
        source
    )

    SELECT
        cc.clinic_id,
        cc.doctor_id,
        cc.patient_id,
        cc.service_id,

        cc.appointment_id,
        cc.disruption_case_id,

        GREATEST(
            cc.exception_ends_at,
            NOW()
        ),

        GREATEST(
            cc.exception_ends_at,
            NOW()
        ) + INTERVAL '30 days',

        'active',
        50,
        NOW(),

        cc.decision_note,
        'disruption_management'

    FROM case_context cc

    WHERE cc.decision = 'waitlist'

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS waitlist_id,
        disruption_case_id,
        status AS waitlist_status
),

effective_waitlist AS (
    SELECT
        iw.waitlist_id,
        iw.disruption_case_id,
        iw.waitlist_status

    FROM inserted_waitlist iw

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        aw.id AS waitlist_id,
        aw.disruption_case_id,
        aw.status AS waitlist_status

    FROM appointment_waitlist aw

    INNER JOIN case_context cc
        ON cc.disruption_case_id =
           aw.disruption_case_id

    WHERE cc.decision = 'waitlist'
      AND aw.status = 'active'

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM inserted_waitlist
      )

    LIMIT 1
),

waitlisted_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments a

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',

        cancellation_reason =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    cc.decision_note,
                    ''
                ),
                'ورود بیمار به لیست انتظار پس از تغییر برنامه پزشک'
            ),

        cancelled_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    INNER JOIN effective_waitlist ew
        ON ew.disruption_case_id =
           cc.disruption_case_id

    WHERE a.id = cc.appointment_id
      AND a.status IN (
          'pending',
          'confirmed'
      )

    RETURNING
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.status,
        a.cancellation_reason,
        a.cancelled_at
),

waitlisted_case AS (
    UPDATE appointment_disruption_cases dc

    SET
        status = 'waitlisted',
        patient_decision = 'waitlist',

        decision_note =
            cc.decision_note,

        responded_at = NOW(),
        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    INNER JOIN effective_waitlist ew
        ON ew.disruption_case_id =
           cc.disruption_case_id

    INNER JOIN waitlisted_appointment wa
        ON wa.appointment_id =
           cc.appointment_id

    WHERE dc.id = cc.disruption_case_id

    RETURNING
        dc.id AS disruption_case_id,
        dc.status AS case_status
),

more_options_case AS (
    UPDATE appointment_disruption_cases dc

    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN summary.proposed_slot_count > 0
                THEN 'awaiting_reschedule_consent'
            ELSE 'awaiting_waitlist_consent'
        END,

        proposed_slots =
            summary.proposed_slots,

        patient_decision = NULL,
        selected_starts_at = NULL,
        selected_ends_at = NULL,

        decision_note =
            cc.decision_note,

        responded_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context cc

    CROSS JOIN more_slot_summary summary

    WHERE cc.decision = 'more_options'
      AND dc.id = cc.disruption_case_id

    RETURNING
        dc.id AS disruption_case_id,
        dc.status AS case_status,
        dc.proposed_slots
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot
             )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot_state
                WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
                   OR has_conflict = TRUE
                   OR selected_starts_at <= NOW()
             )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM rescheduled_appointment
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN r.decision = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_appointment
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN r.decision = 'waitlist'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM waitlisted_case
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM more_options_case
             )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'disruption_case_not_found'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot
             )
            THEN 'invalid_option_number'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot_state
                WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
             )
            THEN 'selected_slot_blocked'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot_state
                WHERE has_conflict = TRUE
             )
            THEN 'selected_slot_unavailable'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM rescheduled_appointment
             )
            THEN 'rescheduled'

        WHEN r.decision = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_appointment
             )
            THEN 'cancelled'

        WHEN r.decision = 'waitlist'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM waitlisted_case
             )
            THEN 'waitlisted'

        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
             AND (
                SELECT proposed_slot_count
                FROM more_slot_summary
             ) > 0
            THEN 'more_options_ready'

        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM more_options_case
             )
            THEN 'no_more_options_available'

        ELSE 'decision_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'پرونده فعال مطابق شناسه و شماره موبایل واردشده پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot
             )
            THEN 'شماره گزینه انتخاب‌شده در پیشنهادهای این پرونده وجود ندارد.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot_state
                WHERE is_blocked = TRUE
             )
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده اکنون در برنامه پزشک مسدود است.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM selected_slot_state
                WHERE has_conflict = TRUE
             )
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده دیگر در دسترس نیست.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM rescheduled_appointment
             )
            THEN 'زمان جایگزین بیمار ثبت شد.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_appointment
             )
            THEN 'نوبت بیمار لغو شد.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'waitlist'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM waitlisted_case
             )
            THEN 'نوبت قبلی لغو و بیمار با رضایت خود وارد لیست انتظار شد.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
             AND (
                SELECT proposed_slot_count
                FROM more_slot_summary
             ) > 0
            THEN 'گزینه‌های جایگزین جدید برای بیمار آماده شدند.'

        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM more_options_case
             )
            THEN 'در بازه جست‌وجوی جدید زمان آزادی پیدا نشد؛ رضایت بیمار برای ورود به لیست انتظار لازم است.'

        ELSE 'وضعیت پرونده یا نوبت در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    r.decision AS action,

    (
        SELECT disruption_case_id
        FROM case_context
    ) AS disruption_case_id,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM case_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM case_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM case_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM case_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM case_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT old_calendar_event_id
        FROM case_context
    ) AS old_calendar_event_id,

    (
        SELECT new_starts_at
        FROM rescheduled_appointment
    ) AS new_starts_at,

    (
        SELECT new_ends_at
        FROM rescheduled_appointment
    ) AS new_ends_at,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            new_starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE cc.timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM rescheduled_appointment ra
        CROSS JOIN case_context cc
    ) AS new_appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT waitlist_id
        FROM effective_waitlist
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS waitlist_id,

    CASE
        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
            THEN (
                SELECT proposed_slot_count
                FROM more_slot_summary
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS proposed_slot_count,

    CASE
        WHEN r.decision = 'more_options'
            THEN (
                SELECT proposed_slots
                FROM more_options_case
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS proposed_slots,

    CASE
        WHEN r.decision = 'reschedule'
            THEN 'recreate'

        WHEN r.decision IN (
            'cancel',
            'waitlist'
        )
            THEN 'delete'

        ELSE 'none'
    END AS calendar_action

FROM request_data r;

additionalFields.summary: ={{ `نوبت ${$('Build Calendar Delete Context').first().json.patient_name} - ${$('Build Calendar Delete Context').first().json.service_name}` }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
SET
    google_calendar_event_id = $1,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING
    id AS appointment_id,
    google_calendar_event_id;

parameters.content:
## پردازش تصمیم بیمار

شناسه پرونده را از خروجی Workflow شماره 20 بردار.

**decisionهای مجاز:**
- `reschedule`: انتخاب یکی از گزینه‌ها؛ `option_number` الزامی است.
- `more_options`: جست‌وجوی گزینه‌های جدید؛ نوبت فعلی تغییر نمی‌کند.
- `cancel`: لغو نوبت.
- `waitlist`: لغو نوبت قبلی و ورود بیمار به لیست انتظار با رضایت.

برای تست امن، مقدار پیش‌فرض روی `more_options` قرار گرفته است.
